name: Limiter
description: Clamps the pixel values of the selected channels to a minimum and a maximum.

params.name: min
params.description: Lower limit, in code values of `depth` bits (clamped to the depth maximum)

params.name: max
params.description: Upper limit, in code values of `depth` bits (clamped to the depth maximum, so the default is no limit)

params.name: planes
params.description: Bit mask of the channels to limit: 1 green, 2 blue, 4 red, 8 alpha (FFmpeg's GBRAP plane order)

params.name: depth
params.description: Bit depth the `min` and `max` values refer to; 8 for ordinary 8-bit video
